summary: AC-ADVERSE is not met: legal propositions can validate without any primary_source_verified validation. The validator requires adverse authority but omits the mandatory primary-source rung, and FAM-04 demonstrates this omission with a LEGAL_PROPOSITION and only a citation_linked check. Preventing such a packet from earning VERIFIED_FACT does not require its legal proposition to undergo primary-source verification. This corrected report supersedes my original APPROVE within the same review opening; the original verdict should not justify acceptance. The round-2 record-binding and assertion-coverage corrections remain supported. Independently recorded VAL-SUITE evidence reports 398 passing tests, 81 required paths checked and zero distribution differences, but those passing checks do not cover the missing requirement. This report does not accept work or change the ledger.

evidence: Supplied diff.patch lines 242-329, 1844-1859 and 1880-1889 contain the same ten required family-law orientation fields in config/bootstrap.schema.json, validate_bootstrap.DOMAIN_FIELDS and the intake reference.
Supplied diff.patch lines 2031-2046 update the fictional intake fixture; lines 2574-2585 test the required fields, a complete fixture and refusal of an adverse_facts answer of TBD.
Packet independent_validation.results[0] records successful full unittest discovery and repository validation covering 81 required paths.

Supplied diff.patch lines 392-450 restrict authored assertion categories and require assertion/source fields; lines 1399-1456 refuse authored VERIFIED_FACT, enforce contract-source references and reconcile fact_basis with declared assertions.

Supplied diff.patch lines 1584-1659 find the attested record by canonical digest and verify its schema, task, revision, contract hash, submission, validation, rung, operator, attested fields and exact declared claim.

Supplied diff.patch lines 1663-1789 require ACCEPTED status, reverified supporting records and coverage of every declared assertion before deriving VERIFIED_FACT; contradictory, inconclusive, synthetic, missing-record and attestation-only paths cannot earn that status.

Supplied diff.patch lines 2360-2399 and 2544-2571 exercise successful record-backed verification, unrelated claims, uncovered assertions, incorrect task/revision/contract identities and missing records. Packet independent_validation.results[0] records the passing 398-test suite.
The packet's contract.parent.objective requires adverse authority and primary-source verification for legal propositions. AC-ADVERSE expressly states that legal issue packets require both.
Supplied diff.patch lines 1439-1456 compute source_checks but do not require any for a fact-asserting packet. The LEGAL_PROPOSITION branch checks only non-empty adverse_authority before returning.

Supplied diff.patch lines 1183-1206 show FAM-04 declaring a LEGAL_PROPOSITION while mapping its sole validation, VAL-CITATION-LINKAGE, to citation_linked. Lines 1140-1160 contain only that machine-runnable check and no primary-source review.

Supplied diff.patch lines 2157-2161 expect every example, including FAM-04, to validate; lines 2224-2227 test missing adverse authority but not the missing primary-source rung. The independently passing 398-test suite therefore does not demonstrate enforcement of this requirement.

The existing binding safeguards remain present: diff.patch lines 1512-1581 enforce attestation fields, submission identities and observation-time bounds; lines 1620-1659 verify record identities; lines 1763-1785 require record verification before awarding VERIFIED_FACT or a satisfied primary-source rung. Those safeguards apply only when a primary-source validation exists.
Supplied diff.patch lines 636-1209 provide four fictional packets covering docket, support, custody and an issue brief; each declares one workstream and synthetic: true.
Supplied diff.patch lines 2157-2161 validate every example contract under the implemented closed domain rules. The separate omission in those rules is recorded under AC-ADVERSE.

Supplied diff.patch lines 2318-2333 require exactly four examples and run every declared command through the acceptance deterministic gate, substituting the current interpreter and isolating fixture risk/dependencies; every runnable validation must report PASSED.
Packet independent_validation.results[0] reports the complete 398-test suite passed, providing recorded execution evidence for the round-1 corrective regression.
Supplied diff.patch lines 1310-1316 and 1419-1429 preserve the command requirement through citation_linked and the attestation-only primary_source_verified rung.

Supplied diff.patch lines 1863-1874 make the controller integration solely by registering family_law in work_packet.DOMAIN_MODULES; the supplied diff contains no acceptance-controller, gate-floor or risk-tier changes.

Supplied diff.patch lines 2229-2271 test preserved stored-revision replay, reported domain shortfalls, refusal of new noncompliant contracts and revision into compliance; lines 1674-1678 prevent legacy domain shortfalls from earning fact status.

Supplied diff.patch lines 2590-2684 move generic unregistered-profile fixtures to civil-rights-nc without changing their assertions. Packet independent_validation.results[0] records passing repository checks and zero distribution differences.

contract_failures.what_failed: Primary-source verification is optional for legal propositions. A packet can declare LEGAL_PROPOSITION, provide adverse_authority and validate with only machine-runnable checks. FAM-04 is a concrete admitted example. The contract requires legal issue packets to include primary-source verification; retaining UNVERIFIED_FACT after machine-only acceptance does not satisfy that requirement.
evidence: Packet contract.parent.objective and AC-ADVERSE require primary-source verification for legal propositions.
Supplied diff.patch lines 1439-1456: source_checks is computed, but the propositions branch requires only adverse_authority and never requires a primary_source_verified validation.
Supplied diff.patch lines 1140-1160 and 1183-1206: FAM-04 declares LEGAL_PROPOSITION and only VAL-CITATION-LINKAGE at citation_linked.
Supplied diff.patch lines 2157-2161 and 2224-2227: examples are expected to validate and the legal-proposition regression tests only missing adverse authority.
contract_failures.corrective_action: Within scripts/family_law.py and the allowed schema/tests, refuse a contract declaring LEGAL_PROPOSITION when it has no primary_source_verified validation. Update FAM-04 within examples/family-law to include a command-free primary-source validation for its legal proposition, with the required evidence and criterion linkage. Add a regression demonstrating refusal when that rung is absent and successful validation when present, retaining the existing adverse-authority, attestation-binding, fact-status and stored-versus-new replay safeguards. Re-run VAL-SUITE without changing the acceptance controller or the contract under review.
